summary: W17 is the first v4.4 three-run week (Adj #244): Mon LONG 70 min / Tue Hyp A / Wed T 6×1K / Thu OFF / Fri VO2 5×1000m @ I / Sat Hyp B lift-only / Sun OFF. Target ~20 mpw, the peak under the new template. Monday carries the whole week — it is W17's entire easy fraction, so a yellow §11.C read trims it in minutes and never moves it; Sun is off by rule and there is no punt slot. MONDAY DELIVERED: 70:42 / 7.39 mi @ 9:34/mi, RPE "very easy" — the first long in its programmed slot since W13 after three straight weeks lost (Adj #254). HILL STRIDES REMOVED from the program the same day — program.md now v4.5, no stride slot in any future brief, and §6 carries no lower-body neuromuscular work at all (Adj #255). One watch off the long: miles 7-8 ran 8:36/9:04 below the easy band by choice, at roughly threshold cardiac cost — noise once, a conversation if it repeats at the W18 Mon long (Adj #256). TUESDAY DELIVERED, and it was the best lift day of the Build: the deload paid off exactly where it was supposed to — incline 155×5 came back at RIR 2, clearing the re-attempt gate on the nose and reproducing the W14 line rep-for-rep, so 160 fires W18 Tue with the guard re-registered tighter because 160 already owns miss #1 (Adj #257); the rear-delt posted the repeat RIR 4/4 the nudge protocol asks for, so 145 fires W18 (Adj #258); and the decline crunch put its first full Tue 3×12 at +10 on the board (Adj #262). The counterweight is the arm side — the pushdown's back half collapsed to its worst line at 27.5 in either slot and the preacher opener gave back its click, both on the most favorable Tuesday the slot gets, and the §10.A 2nd-movement decision that was due at the Tue brief went to the athlete (Adj #259/#260/#263). BOTH OPEN ITEMS SETTLED THE SAME EVENING BY DIRECTIVE, so the W18 brief carries neither: the 2nd biceps/triceps movement is PAUSED short-term — preacher + pushdown only with no brief line until it re-surfaces on its own at the W19 Tue brief 8-25, the 4-wk gate staying met and the eligibility banked; the pause buys three full-dose pushdown back-half reads (W17 Sat, W18 Tue, W18 Sat), and a second collapse turns W19 into a load/set-count conversation rather than an expansion (Adj #264/#266); and the DB lateral's soft-opener gate is resolved by taking option (a) — 30 → 35 fires W18 Tue, the opener-RIR condition retired rather than carried, dose unchanged at 6×12 with the last two to failure, reverting only if the front four can't hold the 12 floor (Adj #265). That puts THREE bumps on W18 Tue: incline 160, rear-delt 145, DB lateral 35. WEDNESDAY DELIVERED and it answered its question backwards: the 6×1K ran the 7:50 slow-end ask on the Build's longest T dose (28:49 of work) and came back RPE 7 flat across all six with "mega easy" attached, so the armed reopen toward SLOWER does not fire and disarms — the band 7:45-7:50 stands, but its slow end is now proven comfortable and T joins I as a candidate for being ~5 s/mi conservative, with the W19 cut-down arbitrating both (Adj #267). The athlete then settled the T half by directive the same evening — "we should go faster next T run" — so the band steps 7:45-7:50 to 7:40-7:45, which is not a new estimate but the heat-adjusted reserve Adj #166/#202 deliberately withheld (the W14 3K TT read VDOT 42.85 raw / ~43.5 heat-adjusted, in 80degF). The RPE <=7 anchor is unchanged and still governs, I stays 7:00-7:15 pending Friday, and the W19 cut-down still arbitrates; the first outing at the new band is W18 Wed's 4x1 mi with 90 s rest, opened on pace, reverting on RPE 8+ or a died rep (Adj #271). Cadence 168 throughout corrected the record too: the W16 in-band read was treadmill-specific, not threshold-specific, so the watch is armed at both modalities (Adj #269). That leaves Friday carrying more weight, not less: the 5×1000m @ I is the decisive band test — open at the 7:00 fast end, run the prescribed 90 s JOG recoveries after Sunday's walked ones, full ~17.5 min dose, and a sub-anchor read with the confound removed reopens the band ahead of the W19 cut-down (Adj #251/#252). Cadence watch re-armed at I, next read Fri (Adj #253). Saturday is the first full-dose Hyp B since the deload and fires both held bumps — DB lateral 35→40 (Adj #248) and seated calf 355→365 (Adj #249), whose AM Achilles gate reads Mon 8-17; its pushdown is also the re-read that governs the W18 2nd-movement call. BACK HALF SWAPPED 8-14 by athlete directive (Adj #273): Friday took Hyp B and Saturday takes the VO2 — the third run of the Adj #223/#242 shape, known-tolerated in both directions. FRIDAY DELIVERED, full §3.B dose on every movement, and the two carried bumps split (Adj #274–#281). The calf partially landed 365 — front pair on the 12 floor with a click of reserve each, back pair two short, 44 against 355's two 48s — so it holds at 365 to rebuild the way every prior calf step has (Adj #276). The DB lateral missed 40 outright: 11/8/8/9 with not a single set at the 12 target and all four run to failure against a last-set-to-failure ask, 36 against 48 at 35. That is partly load and partly the Adj #118 pre-fatigue mechanism, so it gets one more exposure with the front three held at RIR 1–2 rather than an immediate revert, and the front two under 11 next Saturday sends it back to 35 (Adj #275). Against that, a third bump was earned — the decline crunch finally cleared the Adj #184/#212/#231 Sat gate with a full 3×10 at +10 and set 3 clean at RIR 1, so +15 fires W18 Sat (Adj #278). The session's real verdict is on the triceps: Adj #273 put this outing 48 h post-threshold with nothing in front of it, the most rested slot Hyp B can get, expressly to test whether Tuesday's back-half collapse was placement — and it reproduced the same shape, set 3 at 8 again, 41 total. Placement is out and the Adj #259 durability reading is confirmed: 27.5 holds a clean front half (best opener at the load in either slot) and will not hold four sets. That is read 1 of the three the Adj #264/#266 pause was bought to collect, and two-for-two points the W19 Tue conversation at load or set count rather than expansion (Adj #277). The elbow itself stayed silent throughout — 13th consecutive clean session. Everything else held with the shape improving underneath: the lat posted its best outing at 165 (31, gate still open on set 3's headroom and set 4's rep — Adj #279), the Sat preacher tied its best total on the cleanest RIR line 60 has produced at the slot (Adj #280), and the row repeated W15's best rep line one short of the full 3×10 for a second time, with the fly on its RPE 7 ask (Adj #281). That leaves one session in the week, and it carries two questions. Saturday's 5×1000m @ I is the decisive band test — open at the 7:00 fast end, 90 s JOG recoveries after Sunday's walked ones and Wednesday's decayed ones, full ~17.5 min dose, RPE 9 governing; sub-anchor there with the confound removed reopens the band ahead of the W19 cut-down (Adj #251/#252). And Saturday morning is the compressed Achilles gate — ~18 h after a calf sweep at a load the tendon has never carried before, against the ~40 h at Z1 that Adj #244 had designed for. Symptomatic reading protects the band test and reverts the calf to 355 at W18 Sat; Mon 8-17 is the confirming second read at ~66 h.

Recoveries decayed to walking, immaterial at 60 s/T (Adj #270). HR 166→186 drift, display-only. ~5.7 mi, road, Vomero Plus; all clean by default — 10th straight quality outing clean.
